_readme: Titles for the people on ribbitcap.com/team, which publishes names and LinkedIn links only (COLLECTION.md s11: no title from LinkedIn, aggregators or memory). Each title is read from the adviser's own Form ADV Schedule A (CRD 165308, annual amendment of 2026-03-30) or from a release that quotes the person with the title; url is that source. Merged onto the site rows by slug through config.json site_api.team_sources. Jordan Angelos ('General Partner' on Crunchbase and NFX only) and Zack Rosen (quoted 'at Ribbit Capital' with no title, Crossmint's release) stay untitled. Built 2026-09-28 from scratch/team-titles.json.
